admission.justification: Realized across review_fact_source.py, memory_verdict_ref.py, modules/closeout_external.py, and review_note.py for both closeout and direct landing, and proved by five pytest functions in mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py.

applicability: Qualifying passed memory rounds written into knowledge/history/<leaf>.json by leaf closeout or direct landing, and committed closed history read by review_note.
conditions: owner_review_fact passes the bound contract's worktree_group and task_root into collected_verdict_ref, which computes exact relative paths under role-reports/, legacy task-reports, or task notes/reports/ without folder-name substring search.
References already in notes/reports/<rel> form are preserved as collected paths.
Pre-existing unmappable references (such as bare filenames) are written as recorded and named via unmapped_verdict_ref_note in both fresh closeout and committed_review_note recovery.
exclusions: Already-closed history records on main (no product route rewrites frozen history).
Task documents' recordedRounds text and step-up lastVerdict displays, which stay as originally recorded.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_memory_verdict_ref.py (tree 0fec81b218c6563f1bfcec58b72b53c8516aee1a; focused pytest -n 0: 50 passed, 14 deselected, 22 subtests passed)

statement: owner_review_fact maps a qualifying memory round's verdictRef to the collected notes/reports/<rel> form using exact relative paths under the contract's role-reports/, legacy task-reports alias, or task notes/reports/, serving both closeout and direct landing, while writing unmappable pre-existing references as recorded and naming them in the closeout/landing answer.
title: History review facts record collected notes/reports/<rel> verdictRef
